renderInvariant: Existing vertex positions, normals, UVs, vertex/triangle order and material slots are unchanged. This is additive authoring metadata only.

components: Authored horizontal source path station in metres
Roadway elevation at that source station, in Atlas world Y metres
_highway_source.sweptFaces: Taken directly from each construction section's distance and y, and propagated through the exact emitted triangle order, including winding reversal.
_highway_source.loftedSupportsAndBearings: Computed once from the emitted vertex XZ using the producer's inverse construction frame; deck elevation is evaluated from the original elevation profile. It never comes from texture UV.u or vertex world Y.
_highway_source.interpolation: Interpolate normally on a swept face. Stations wrap at the closed route origin; use ownership.pathLength and closedRoute when handling cyclic distance. A support loft crossing that origin can contain the coordinate discontinuity, so its pier-base mask must use the owning support record, not an interpolated station.

_highway_face.interpolation: All three vertices of a triangle carry the same integer mask; preserve raw 0..31 values. Do not normalize to 0..1.

meaning.CAP: Actual upper planar cap/top of an authored section or loft; use the material slot and original geometry normal to select the intended part.
meaning.CHAMFER: Actual small section bevel, chamfered support corner, or short loft bevel band.
meaning.DRIP: The two authored sides of the slab drip kerf; never a texture-tile border.
meaning.END: A closed longitudinal section end or bearing-pocket section step.
meaning.ROAD_SIDE: A parapet face pointing toward the carriageway, including its battered inner face.

fields.pathLength: Complete horizontal source route length in metres
fields.closedRoute: True exactly when the source path closes
fields.ownerRanges: Array of {start,count,support}. start/count are vertex units, not float offsets, index offsets or triangle numbers.
fields.supportTable: Array of {index,bottom,top,station}, indexed in the original structure.supports order. Bottom/top retain exact Atlas values, including nonzero and negative bases.

ownership.ranges: Ranges are contiguous, nonoverlapping, cover the complete part and align to whole triangles. support=-1 means explicitly unowned; support=0 is the first real support.
ownership.assignedOwners: Pier lofts, both steel bearing plates, the elastomer bearing pad and that support's deck diaphragm carry the exact construction owner index. Main slab, route joints and parapets remain unowned.
consumerPreparation: At residency preparation, walk each owner range once and read supportTable[range.support] when support>=0.

For shaders that need bottom/top/index, expand those constants to only the necessary geometry attributes or the existing instance/owner representation. Do this once before batching, not once per frame.
Indices are local to one source structure. Resolve or rebase them before merging different structures; copying bottom/top values per vertex avoids a global support lookup.
Pier-base contact uses worldY - owningSupport.bottom. Never use world zero, a texture repeat coordinate, or the minimum Y of a batch containing several piers.
Barrier-lower splash can use worldY - _highway_source.y directly. Slot and original face-normal gates still apply.

Soffit joint logic receives the real station from _highway_source.x and the existing model.detail.joints array. Build a suitable neighbouring-joint representation once during preparation; this module does not add a per-frame search or a new shader.
Placement weathering remains opt-in. These coordinates do not enable or bake any dirt, base band, wetness or material variation.

gltf.extras: primitive.extras.highwayContent.ownership retains the same range/table contract in the review GLB. Three's loader exposes custom attribute names in lowercase.
gltf.caution: A consumer that reindexes, splits, merges or reorders vertices must carry owner ranges through that operation or expand the required owner fields beforehand.

cost.persistentVertexData: CPU arrays and glTF storage: 9 additional bytes per vertex, comprising two Float32 values and one raw unnormalized Uint8 mask.
cost.attributeCount: Two additional buffer attributes; no new draw call or material slot.
cost.rangeData: A small run-length owner table per part, plus a small support table; ownerless contiguous geometry collapses to one range.
cost.activeWebGpuVertexData: Three 0.185.1 active WebGPU upload: 12 additional bytes per vertex. createAttribute expands the unnormalized Uint8 mask to Uint32Array; the source vec2 remains two Float32 values. This excludes optional owner fields expanded by the consumer and buffer allocation overhead.

implementationSource.observedRule: When normalized is false, Uint8Array and Uint16Array are converted to Uint32Array before upload.

cost.statisticsNote: statistics.ownershipBytes reports stored CPU attribute bytes, not active WebGPU upload size. For tiny-check: 31,884 vertices use 286,956 stored attribute bytes and 382,608 active WebGPU attribute bytes before optional expanded owner fields.

apiCorrection: highwayFrameAt currently returns elevation as .y, not .center.y. The material placement-mask specification's .center.y wording must not be copied into a consumer.
